purpose: Add three gospel-centered, public-domain hymns with independently retained text, tune, and rights evidence.
guardrails: Import only when the source page marks both words and tune Public Domain.
Retain the exact source page and MIDI checksums with every record.
Keep Scripture references as topical indexes; KJV Scripture remains primary.

entries.title: Blessed Be the Name
entries.musicAttribution: BLESSED NAME, attributed to William H. Havergal and arranged by Ralph E. Hudson and William J. Kirkpatrick, 1887-1888; public-domain MIDI distributed with the cited Timeless Truths record.

entries.title: At Calvary
entries.musicAttribution: AT CALVARY by Daniel B. Towner, 1895; public-domain MIDI distributed with the cited Timeless Truths record.

entries.title: Nothing but the Blood
entries.musicAttribution: PLAINFIELD by Robert Lowry, published 1876; public-domain MIDI distributed with the cited Timeless Truths record.
